bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
candidate=$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:roommig-51a6734) || exit 41
live=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1) || exit 42
test "$candidate" = "$live" || exit 43
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 44
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.RestartCount}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = 0 || exit 45
docker logs --since 15m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY bot_id=8872855519' || exit 46
q(){ docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
test "$(q "SELECT CASE WHEN to_regclass('public.room_join_links') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END")" = 1 || exit 47
c=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='room_join_links' AND column_name IN ('room_id','token','enabled')") || exit 48
test "$c" = 3 || exit 49
test "$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='announcement' AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL")" -gt 0 || exit 50
echo ROOM_LIVE_SCHEMA_AND_IMAGE_READBACK_PASS
